strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
As for which point to head for...
Hm...
Captain, what's wrong?
This feeling... not good!
I see... it's just as Lady Haman said.
What!? An enemy attack!?
Those are... Zeon mobile suits!?
They targeted us! They were watching our fight with the Vegans!
...I'm heading out.
Now then, who's first?
You're all fired up, Excellen.
Not being tense is fine, though that alone won't keep you alive.
They take us lightly.
A force that small... mobile suits from before the Gryps Conflict,
...and a few models I've never seen.
Battles aren't decided by numbers or specs... Justice and conviction...
...whoever's are stronger wins...!
...How cool.
Don't think childish drivel will win you this! War is love and loyalty...!
That is everything!
Huh? Is that guy okay?
Focus! All units, commence attack!
Grrr! I didn't think you'd go this far!
But don't think this is the end. The battle has only just begun!
Can the Full Burnern catch him!?
Stop, Uraki! We don't have the forces to chase him that far.
That's right. Avoid splitting our forces.
We'll have to settle for driving them off...
...Haman, why can't you see this is no time for humans to fight each other...!
It's over. But...
...Worrying, huh? Just a recon unit, and they still gave us a hard time.
Yeah...
But we don't have time to complain.
...As in the Gryps Conflict, having the forces isn't everything.
Are you afraid of... a tragedy like his?
...Kamille, you mean. Yes... We can't have a battle like that again.
Judau, too, abandoned the Earth Sphere and left for Jupiter's gravity.
And this is no time for us to be held by gravity...
So, what now?
We have to pursue the unidentified force heading for Earth.
...And I hear the Vega Star Federation is stirring near the moon...
Anyway... nothing starts unless we move.
...Vega Star Federation, I won't let you do as you please...!
(...Amuro, you too are still held by Earth's gravity...)
